summary: xAI launched a free Microsoft Word (and PowerPoint/Excel) add-in that lets Grok draft, rewrite, research and pull connector data directly inside Office documents.

practices.reason: Teams integrating Grok into Office workflows would need to add and manage this Microsoft Marketplace add-in and its connector permissions.
practices.quote: Grok for Word is a free Microsoft 365 add-in. Add it from the Microsoft Marketplace , and work directly with Grok in your documents.

practices.reason: The add-in describes connector-based retrieval (email, SharePoint, Google Drive) feeding into document generation, a pattern relevant to retrieval design but not detailed as a technique.
practices.quote: The add-in is also able to leverage connectors ; ask it to draft from recent emails, or files in your SharePoint or Google Drive.
